title.en: Seijo no Imouto no Shirinugui wo Ousetsu Katta, Tada no Jijo de Gozaimasu ~Shazaisaki no Shishijinkoku de Nazeka Reikoku Kuro Ookami Heika ni Misomeraremashita!?~
Migawari Konyaku Shananoni, Gin Ookami Heika ga Doushitemo Hanashite Kuremasen!
Watashi wa Tada no Jijo desu node - Hissori Kurashitai no ni, Kishi Ou-sama ga Nigashitekuremasen
Honmono no Seijo Janai to Bareta no ni, Outei Denka ni Semararete imasu
Ochibure Saijo no Koufuku Heika ni Suterareta no de, Saiai no Hito wo Sukui ni ikimasu
Kono Ai wa, Kokuou Heika no Gomeirei Janai - Ohitori-sama Kibou no Reijou desu ga, Funaka na Kishi ga Hanashitekuremasen!
Watashi, Seijo. Ima, Kankinsarete Iru no
Usotsuki Heika ga Watashi ni Shuuchaku Suru Riyuu
Gimai ga Seijo dakara to Konyakuhaki Saremashita ga, Watashi wa Yousei no Itoshigo desu
Seijo no Ane desu ga, Naze ka Miwaku no Koushaku-sama ni Tsukaeru Koto ni narimashita
Watashi wa Teki ni narimasen! - Aku no Majutsushi ni Tensei shitakedo, Shinu no wa Gomen na no de Scenario ni Sakaratte Ikinobimasu
Hakoiri Koujou wa Shikou no Koi wo Onozomi desu! - Risou no Tonogata wo Sagasu Tabi ni Demasu. Tadashi, Utsukushisha Igai Mitomemasen!?
Senjou no Seijo ~Imouto no Kawari ni Koushaku Kishi ni Totsugu Koto ni narimashita ga, Ima wa Shiawase desu~
Outaishi Denka wa Koukyuu ni Uranaishi wo Goshomou desu
Binbou Kishi ni Yomeiri Shita Hazu ga!? Yajin Reijou wa Koutaishihi ni Natte mo Ryuu wo Karitai
Yomei Wazuka No Intai Seijo Wa Reikoku Koshaku To No Yakkai Harai Kon o Okashitai!
Konyaku haki sareta muhyoujou reijou ga shiawase ni naru made ~Kinmusaki no tennen tarashi kishidan-chou-sama ga torottoro ni amayakashite dekiai shite kuru no desu ga!?~
